RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint (stickup-v2-taunts-safe.json) after every step; verification law (your 'clean' claim must survive parent frame sampling — twice now it hasn't); media proof standard; no AI faces; no invented canon; commit incrementally. NEW CHECKLIST ITEM for all future promo work: taunt poses must be deformation-tested at render — any pose that breaks the skin weights is cut or re-choreographed within the safe range; exploded geometry never ships.
